description.narrative: (Bangladesh): The Strengthening Political Landscape (SPL) activity strengthens the skills of political party members and citizens; advocates for more inclusive party policies and practices; and mitigates intra- and inter- party conflict. The SPL activity is designed to train political leaders with conflict mitigation skills, to enhance their leadership abilities, and promote gender equality and democratic inclusiveness. The consolidation of power by the Awami League has left limited political space for opposition political parties to participate in political public debate. In this context, the SPL activity provides a platform for political party members to participate in multi-party dialogues, both on social and traditional media platforms, where they can openly express their views on current political issues. USAID will conduct fellowship training programs for young and senior political leaders to develop leadership and political skills, and to assist in building political parties based on democratic principles and practices. The activity will also focus on training women in order to achieve the 33 percent quota for women's representation in all political party committees. USAID will continue to utilize digital platforms to ensure political parties are able to produce and broadcast digital events, and to develop digital databases to increase their ability to recruit online members. The activity will train candidates on electoral rules, electoral codes of conduct and campaign management, and conduct other elections activity in the next fiscal year. The activity will contribute to "Freedom of Expression" ($1.6m) and GBV($787,500) and GBV-CEFM($787,500) earmark. This activity is in line with the State-USAID Integrated Country Strategy (ICS) Mission Goal Two and the U.S. government development objective of "Improved Democratic Systems that Promote Transparency, Accountability, and Integrity."
